caption: Waddenhaven, Nes
composition: Yacht basin and the low brick edge of Nes · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Waddenhaven at Nes is the yacht basin on the south side of Ameland, with moored boats, wooden jetties, and the low brick houses of the village behind. The ferry dam next to it is under renovation through mid-October 2026, so that working quay is not this view. The sky is overcast, about 14.3°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h. No ship name is readable. Holwerd, on the mainland, is a different place.
